name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx multi-site web server for three virtual hosts, including static content, TLS, security headers, fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as host-level caching services, including authenticated Redis on port 6379 and its required logging and configuration management.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a Python FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, including its virtual environment, dependencies, local PostgreSQL database, environment configuration, and systemd service on port 8000.
